item.text: {"prompt":"A purely nonrepresentational abstract painting that evokes cognition as a shifting interplay of possibility, constraint, revision, and unresolved space. Square composition, painting extending edge to edge. A deep ultramarine field holds uneven masses of smoky violet and near-black, interrupted by thin washes of translucent celadon. Concentrate the greatest density slightly off-center: restless vermilion strokes, scraped ivory ridges, and small eruptions of acidic yellow overlap, interrupt, and partially obscure one another. Let gestures begin decisively and dissolve into dry-brush hesitation; let buried colors reappear through scumbled surfaces. Repeat a few irregular rhythms with subtle variations, never forming a grid or diagram. Set thick impasto against nearly bare, luminous passages. Broad areas of quiet pale gray-green create spatial tension around the compressed activity, while a few isolated dark strokes pull attention toward the edges. Convey multiplicity without a central narrator, coherence continually forming and loosening, precision beside ambiguity. Visceral pigment, visible bristle marks, rubbed stains, palette-knife abrasion, layered opacity and translucency. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, wall, room, or gallery setting; only the square painting filling the entire image."}
